features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance textile printing

items.title: 16 Epson i3200-A1 Printheads
items.desc: Double the printhead count of the FoilJet 8 Head, 16 Epson i3200-A1 heads deliver high-resolution output at up to 1200 x 2400 dpi across a full 3200 mm print width for wide-format foil and sublimation production.

items.title: Maglev Linear Motor System
items.desc: Magnetic levitation linear motor drives the carriage with ultra-smooth, vibration-free movement, ensuring consistent ink placement accuracy and precise foil adhesive registration across the full wide-format print zone.

items.title: Dual Dryer System
items.desc: Two integrated drying zones provide rapid ink setting and vibrant colour retention across wide-format foil media, ensuring consistent adhesive activation at all operating speeds.

items.title: 6-Zone Cooling System
items.desc: Zoned temperature control across the full print width maintains stable printhead operating conditions and prevents thermal distortion during extended wide-format foil and sublimation production runs.

items.title: White Ink Circulation and Ink Shortage Alarm
items.desc: Continuous white ink channel circulation prevents pigment settling during idle periods, while real-time ink shortage alerts notify operators before any production interruption occurs.

items.title: Anti-Collision Carriage Protection
items.desc: Sensor-based carriage protection detects obstacles in the full 3200 mm print path and immediately halts movement to protect all 16 printheads from contact damage during fabric or media handling.

items.title: Fully Automated Ink Supply System
items.desc: Automated bulk ink delivery to all 16 heads simultaneously maintains consistent pressure across the wide print zone, reducing manual refill frequency and supporting long uninterrupted production runs.

items.title: Mesh Belt Conveying System
items.desc: Open-mesh belt transport allows airflow through the media during drying while maintaining stable, accurate fabric positioning throughout wide-format foil and sublimation printing and collection.

idealFor.description: Perfectly suited for a wide range of textile applications, delivering exceptional print quality, color vibrancy, and production efficiency across diverse fabric categories.

fabrics.title: Wide-Format Fashion Fabric Foil Printing
fabrics.desc: Precise digital foil adhesive printing across full 3200 mm width for sarees, dress materials, and fashion fabrics where wide repeats, border designs, or full-width foil effects are required.

fabrics.title: Ethnic and Bridal Wear Production at Scale
fabrics.desc: High-resolution foil placement across wide fabric runs for lehenga, dupatta, sherwani, and bridal fabric manufacturers producing large collections with intricate wide-repeat foil pattern detailing.

fabrics.title: Large-Format Home Textile Foil Effects
fabrics.desc: Foil and specialty effect printing on wide-format cushion covers, curtains, table linen, and decorative home textiles for premium retail, export, and gifting markets.

fabrics.title: Wide-Format Sublimation Production
fabrics.desc: High-speed sublimation printing across 3200 mm on polyester performance fabrics, sportswear, and wide-format soft furnishing textiles requiring vibrant, wash-fast colour output at scale.

fabrics.title: Flag, Banner, and Wide-Format Soft Signage
fabrics.desc: 3200 mm print width and foil plus sublimation compatibility make the FoilJet 16 Head well suited to wide-format flags, banners, exhibition textiles, and retail soft signage applications.

fabrics.title: Custom and Designer Wide-Format Textiles
fabrics.desc: Wide-format foil and sublimation output for boutique fashion brands, textile designers, and sampling studios working with wide repeat patterns or large-format design elements.

fabrics.title: Transfer Paper and Specialty Media Printing
fabrics.desc: Dual media compatibility enables wide-format sublimation transfer paper printing alongside direct fabric output, serving manufacturers who operate both workflows from a single machine.
